metadata.title: Jamestown, Rhode Island — Government, Meetings, Projects, Announcements & Jobs
metadata.publisher: Independent research for Jamestown Island News
metadata.disclaimer: This independent directory is compiled from publicly available government records and official public sources, including the Town of Jamestown, its school district, public agencies, and the Jamestown Fire Department. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Town of Jamestown. Names, roles, contacts, meeting schedules, project details, job openings, and announcements may change. Please confirm information directly with the responsible office when needed. Listed contacts are those published for official or organizational business; missing information has not been guessed.
metadata.privacy: Role/business contacts only. No residential addresses, applicant files, victim identities, or private correspondence are extracted into contact records. Links lead to official records that may contain additional information.
metadata.time_policy: Meeting EventStart is used rather than CMS PostStartDate. A future calendar entry is not proof of a filed agenda. Historical scheduled events are not automatically marked held.

missing_value_policy.not published: Field absent from the cited source(s), not a claim that it is unavailable everywhere.
missing_value_policy.not confirmed: Unresolved, conflicting, inaccessible, or not independently established.
missing_value_policy.null: Unknown numeric/date value; reason supplied in an adjacent field.

projects_and_decisions.title: Fort Getty long-range planning
projects_and_decisions.summary: October 19 minutes reproduced in the November 2 packet record a 3–1 vote adopting the ad hoc final report as the foundation for a comprehensive plan. This does not approve every recommendation, final design, future bond or construction contract.
projects_and_decisions.next_verification: Track incoming council decisions, cost estimates, permitting, public input and any bond proposal.

projects_and_decisions.title: Fort Getty lower bathroom, Lot 22 and access work
projects_and_decisions.summary: October 19 report describes lower-bathroom renovation aimed at opening before the 2027 season, tent-site relocation permitting, Lot 22 roadway/debris work, accessible parking/trail access evaluation, parking cleanup and signage reassessment.
projects_and_decisions.next_verification: Verify permits, procurement, actual expenditures and 2027 opening.

projects_and_decisions.title: Fort Getty Pier possible RIDEM lease
projects_and_decisions.summary: RIDEM expressed interest in operating the pier under a long-term lease for commercial/aquaculture uses. Council removed the authorization item from consent while staff would brief Harbor and obtain feedback.
projects_and_decisions.next_verification: Obtain Harbor recommendation and any draft/executed lease before reporting a transfer.

projects_and_decisions.title: Fort Getty commercial boat/trailer storage policy
projects_and_decisions.status: Concept endorsed by consensus; no vote taken October 5
projects_and_decisions.summary: Council endorsed a one-year pilot at no fee and sent rules to Harbor for enforcement refinements, incorporation in its rule book, and return for council ratification. This was not a final voted adoption.
projects_and_decisions.next_verification: Verify final rules and council ratification before reporting the program as fully authorized.

projects_and_decisions.title: Water meter replacement and EyeOnWater
projects_and_decisions.summary: Town homepage reports about 90% completion and nearly 1,600 replacements, with Badger AMI meters and EyeOnWater consumption/leak alerts. The CMS date is not a reliable date of that progress measurement.
projects_and_decisions.next_verification: Confirm current completion percentage; use the town-linked enrollment guide.

projects_and_decisions.title: Water supply and distribution study
projects_and_decisions.responsible_body: Public Works / Pare / Water & Sewer Board
projects_and_decisions.summary: September 21 minutes describe system modeling, off-island interconnection options, island groundwater sources, more than 400 well records, and testing of water at the Route 138/North Road pump station.
projects_and_decisions.next_verification: Locate final Pare report and Water Resources Board presentation; do not report new water supply as approved.

projects_and_decisions.title: Water planning municipal infrastructure grant
projects_and_decisions.summary: RI Infrastructure Bank announced a $112,500 Jamestown grant for water infrastructure planning. An award is not proof of final study acceptance or construction completion.
projects_and_decisions.next_verification: Check the next relevant agenda, minutes or project update.

projects_and_decisions.title: Swinburne and Douglas Street water mains
projects_and_decisions.summary: September 21 report says replacement of small steel piping on Swinburne Street was continuing, with Douglas Street work to follow, connecting properties to mains.
projects_and_decisions.next_verification: Obtain completion and restoration dates; September progress does not prove November completion.

projects_and_decisions.title: North Road water main replacement
projects_and_decisions.summary: October 5 minutes explain delays involving federal historic-review requirements; the town planned to continue state permitting while moving the federal allocation to the sewer equipment project.
projects_and_decisions.next_verification: Verify permits, replacement financing, bid award and construction schedule.

projects_and_decisions.title: Wastewater treatment equipment upgrade
projects_and_decisions.summary: October 5 consent action authorizes reallocation of $2.5 million in Congressionally Directed Spending to the upcoming sewer treatment plant equipment project. The minutes report EPA indicated it would authorize the change; execution/disbursement is a separate step.
projects_and_decisions.next_verification: Confirm EPA amendment, final design, procurement and construction timeline.

projects_and_decisions.title: Sewer outfall investigation / facilities plan
projects_and_decisions.summary: September report records an underwater outfall survey that had not located the diffuser pipes; further investigation and a RIDEM report were due. Staff and engineers also reviewed comments on the wastewater facilities plan.
projects_and_decisions.next_verification: Retrieve the final outfall investigation, RIDEM response and later repair decisions; do not infer a current discharge failure.

projects_and_decisions.title: Veolia water-treatment staffing contract
projects_and_decisions.summary: September 21 utility minutes authorize an extension through 2033. The first-year amount is $640,505; later years are negotiable subject to the stated index cap. Town staff retain raw-water and distribution functions, and specified staffing credits apply.
projects_and_decisions.amount_type: first year contract amount, not five-year total
projects_and_decisions.next_verification: Obtain signed extension and annual invoices/credits before calculating realized cost.

projects_and_decisions.title: Local road paving RIDOT grant
projects_and_decisions.summary: October 5 consent action accepts a $147,396 grant with $294,792 in town matching funds and spending commitment by December 31, 2029.
projects_and_decisions.next_verification: Link final street list, construction contract and actual spending. Combined grant plus match is $442,188.

projects_and_decisions.title: Potter’s Cove / Freebody Drive stormwater design
projects_and_decisions.summary: RIIB announced $115,000 for design/engineering of runoff mitigation near Potter’s Cove, including Freebody Drive drainage/access features. This is not a completed construction announcement.
projects_and_decisions.next_verification: Verify design, permits and separate construction funding.

projects_and_decisions.title: Senior Center renovation and return to West Street
projects_and_decisions.status: Renovation; reopening scheduled in latest reviewed minutes
projects_and_decisions.summary: Older homepage notice describes an approximately $950,000 renovation at 6 West Street. October 19 minutes give a November 2, 10 a.m. reopening ceremony. The ceremony date is past; actual reopening was not independently observed.
projects_and_decisions.next_verification: Confirm current service location/hours and actual opening; replace stale June-completion/golf-clubhouse notice.

projects_and_decisions.title: Bryer Beach native planting restoration
